menu_curtain.title: Midnight Overture — The Shop Wakes
menu_curtain.identity: A chiming six-beat question with a delayed piano reply; warm suspended harmony opens into a singing celesta refrain.

select_dressing.title: Roll Call — Pocket-Sized Heroes
select_dressing.identity: A dotted toy-trumpet salute answered by clipped clarinet; snare rudiments and two-beat tuba bass make a confident miniature parade.

combat_toys.title: Wind-Up Parade — Ratchet Riot
combat_toys.identity: A low toy-piano riff in a 3+3+2 accent, springy octave bass and answering brass; the B theme opens into a broad minor-key melody.

combat_spoons.title: Cutlery Brigade — Drawer Funk
combat_spoons.identity: Muted-trumpet funk built around a falling sixth, syncopated slap bass and offbeat spoon knocks; a clavinet solo makes room between the hooks.

combat_clockwork.title: Gearworks — Escapement
combat_clockwork.identity: A clipped square lead with rests on the downbeat; a two-bar machine groove and chromatic B7 turnaround, contrasted with a longer glassy refrain.

combat_carousel.title: Carousel Chase — Crooked Horses
combat_carousel.identity: A wheeling accordion melody over walking bass; clarinet takes an eight-bar detour through a diminished chord before the carnival tune returns.

combat_overtime.title: Midnight Stampede — Porcelain Rush
combat_overtime.identity: A bell riff that leaps up a ninth then tumbles into a fast two-step break; long string answers and a half-time tom passage create pressure without a repeated march.

combat_lasttrain.title: Toy Train Express — No More Stops
combat_lasttrain.identity: A train-flute pickup rising through a minor sixth over rolling jungle drums; plucked strings reply in a lower register while the train keeps moving.

boss_ringmaster.title: The Ringmaster — Velvet & Iron
boss_ringmaster.identity: An organ ostinato in descending half-steps answered by low brass; heavy half-time toms turn into a rock charge and a rising theatrical second subject.

boss_clown.title: Jack-in-the-Box — Smile with Teeth
boss_clown.identity: A lopsided descending music-box hook with delayed spring accents, deep half-time 808 and bass clarinet taunts; a short crooked waltz-like phrase interrupts the grin.

shop_gold.title: Ka-Ching Swing — Coins on the Counter
shop_gold.identity: A cheeky honky-tonk pickup, falling chromatic approach notes and a muted-trumpet reply over a walking jazz bass; an eight-bar piano solo opens the till.

shop_layaway.title: Window Shopping — After-Hours Neon
shop_layaway.identity: A relaxed city-pop chorus with a vocal-shaped electric-piano melody, suspended guitar voicings and a warm descending bass; marimba takes a luminous middle eight.

shop_dream.title: The Dream Counter — A Waltz through Glass
shop_dream.identity: A breathing three-quarter celesta waltz with an upward sixth, harp responses and a chromatic minor-subdominant passage; no pop backbeat or shared bass riff.

endless_neverclose.title: Open All Night — Lights on the Roof
endless_neverclose.identity: A sustained supersaw chorus shaped around repeated high F notes and a wide answering leap; piano offbeats and octave disco bass drive a new bright dance theme.

endless_encore.title: One More Encore — Brass on the Barricade
endless_encore.identity: A brass anthem with an anacrusis and a long held high D; live-rock drums and straight eighth guitar chords turn into a stomping half-time singalong before the final refrain.
